verdict.rationale: Deel's founders page lists O-1A, H-1B, E-2, L-1 and the EB-2 NIW and EB-1A green-card paths, and promises help securing 'the right visa or green card'. A free eligibility check with personalized advice supports choosing a visa, but the materials do not lay out the decision guidance themselves. TN and cap-exempt H-1B routes are never mentioned. missing for 10: TN coverage, cap-exempt H-1B routes, published guidance comparing options in the provider's own materials, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation

citations.quote: We have the immigration experience and know-how to help founders secure the right visa or green card for them. O-1A EB-2NIW EB1-A L-1 E-2 H-1B
Start with a free eligibility check and get personalized advice tailored to your profile and goals.
Quickly assess visa options with results delivered within 48 hours, including a cost breakdown and document requirements.
